name: chunk_gated_delta_rule_fwd
description: Chunked gated delta-rule forward. q and k are [B,T,H,K], v is [B,T,H,V], and g and beta are [B,T,H]. q, k and v share a dtype, and the generic kernel rejects FP32 q/k/v. Per sequence and head, decay the state by exp(g), subtract the decayed state prediction from v, weight the correction by beta, and add its outer product with k to the state. Project the updated state with q scaled by scale (default K**-0.5). Optionally L2-normalize q and k before the recurrence. Return a new [B,T,H,V] tensor in the shared q/k/v dtype and, when requested, a new FP32 [num_sequences,H,K,V] final state; otherwise the second return is None. An initial state supplies the starting state without being modified. Packed inputs use B=1 and cu_seqlens to delimit independent sequences; the Torch reference exercises the unpacked path.
